entities.name: Princess Lucrezia
entities.description: Legendary human wizard who ruled the city-state of Lucrezia in south-western Jamuraa, constantly at war with Fysmatan.

entities.name: Lucrezia
entities.description: City-state in south-western Jamuraa ruled by the Princess.

entities.name: Fysmatan
entities.description: Port city on the Sea of Serenity ruled by a shah, at war with Lucrezia.

entities.name: Lucrezian marines
entities.description: Elite unit of Lucrezia's navy that enslaved the Unawanna.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenaries led by Adira Strongheart who opposed Lucrezia and freed the Unawanna.

entities.name: Unawanna
entities.description: Tribe of island natives enslaved by Lucrezian marines.

events.summary: Lucrezian marines enslave the Unawanna to build a flotilla of warships.
events.quote: Lucrezian marines had enslaved the Unawanna

events.summary: The Robaran Mercenaries attack the marines, free the slaves and sell the new ships to Fysmatan.
